question: Which football player was the highest goal scorer in the 3rd edition of the SAFF U-18 Women's Football Championship held at Jamshedpur in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lynda Kom.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The third SAFF U-18 Women's Football Championship has been crowned as India's victory.**
 
• **The JRD Tata Sports Complex in Jamshedpur hosted the 2022 **edition of the **international football tournament for women's under-18 national teams.**
 
• **Lynda Kom**, **who scored a total of five goals, was the most valuable player and top goal scorer in the competition.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Purnima Kumari**

 
 
• ​One of the six girls from the state, **Purnima Kumari (17), who will represent India in the U-17 FIFA World Cup in Bhubaneswar**, has overcome several challenges, including extreme poverty, to pursue her love.
 
• Her family members reside in a mud home in **Simdega district's Jambahar village, **which is part of the **Thethaitangar block**. While** Purnima's mother Chaiti Devi** passed away in 2006 from probable meningitis when she was just one and a half years old, **Purnima's father, Jitu Manjhi (70),** has been bedridden since 2018.
 
 
 
• **Ritu Rani**
 
 
• **​Ritu Rani, an international football player for both the India women's team and Gokulam Kerala,** was born on May 25, 1997. She plays as a defender.
 
• **Ritu presently plays for Gokulam Kerala in India **after having previously played for FC Alakhpura.
 
• In 2017, Ritu was selected to play for the national squad in a series of exhibition games in Malaysia. During the 2019 **Cotif Women's Tournament, **she earned a** senior-level cap for India.**
 
 

1a
